title: Guitar lessons from Professor Andre
summary: He took guitar lessons from Professor Andre, who taught every instrument and rehearsed the band, and quit guitar because he could not sing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Well, when you were playing guitar, did you take lessons?
Yeah, I took lessons on guitar. Mm-hmm. But I tell you why I quit the guitar. I wanted to sing. I couldn't sing. I quit.
Mm-hmm. Did you take lessons from somebody in particular? From Professor Andre.

Oh, he taught guitar too? Yeah, he was a professor. He taught all the ministry. Mm-hmm. Well, how would he give you lessons? Would you be alone or would you be in a crowd? He'd give every man, he'd give so many minutes on a lesson. Mm-hmm .
So he teach every man and he teach the band both?
I see. Get the band in there and rehearse them.

Yeah, after they get lined up on it, then he rehearses them. You see? Yeah. Old man is fine. But play a clarinet too. Now he teach trombone. I never heard him play trombone. He teach trombone. He plays the trumpet, clarinet, violin, bass violin.
